description: CapStone Zoho CRM field reference for Internal Assets (company tools / IAxxxx records).
source: Derived from modules.Internal_Assets in zohoEquipmentFields.json plus Equipments field parity for CapStone IA tab.
notes: Internal_Assets stores CAC-owned tools used for field service — IAxxxx auto-number (field IA_Asset_ID), not customer Equipments (AMD/CAC_Asset_ID).

IA CapStone form is intentionally slimmer than Equipments: no Asset Category, Function, Building, Additional Designator, Asset Type/Type Other, Series/Series Other, Environment, or Confined Space. Those Zoho fields remain on the CRM module and on the Assets tab; CapStone simply does not collect or overwrite them from the IA tab.
Category layouts / dynamic Set Up fields / Subform_1 are Equipments-tab only in CapStone UI (hidden with Asset Category on IA).
Use_Status and Users are Internal_Assets-only fields documented in zohoEquipmentFields.json modules.Internal_Assets.
Use exact picklist strings from Zoho (e.g. Use_Status "Permenant" is misspelled in CRM — match exactly).
